         **Review examples:**
            1. _Fadi Mujahid_, Aug 4, 2026, 3/5: "The app is very good at what it does and I purchased the premium app. However, the app keeps Google Play Service up all the time which results in battery drainage, which is very frustrating. ## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Oct 28, 2026 - Nov 1, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Akhil Panicker_, Oct 28, 2026, 3/5: "Overall a great app (premium user), but facing some issues after android 17 update. widget showing incorrect date on it and makes widget based tracking difficult."
            2. _Tyler Hand_, Nov 1, 2026, 4/5: "Great for tracking meds and daily regimes. One issue I have with the app right now is when you set a reminder to be notifed to complete a task, it will still go off even if you've already completed the task earlier. Another is in order to interact with tasks on the home screen (as a widget), you have to pay a one time fee (I think it's excessiveto be honest). Otherwise it's been very helpful to me."
